load_wer_metric: load the Hugging Face wer (Word Error Rate) metric module using evaluate.load
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the wer metric using launch_gradio_widget
run_wer_evaluation: run a wer evaluation on predictions and references using the loaded wer metric module
compute_wer_score: compute the word error rate score between predicted and reference text sequences
integrate_wer_metric: integrate the wer metric into a huggingface evaluate pipeline for speech recognition evaluation
